entities.name: Rev. Lacy Kirk Williams
entities.description: Pastor of Olivet Baptist Church from 1916; directed migrants to housing, provided childcare and the city's first kindergarten.

entities.name: Walter White
entities.description: NAACP investigator; reported 1919 Black Belt boundaries and 20+ bombings in The Crisis, Oct. 1919.

entities.name: Clyde Ross
entities.description: North Lawndale homebuyer on contract; joined the Contract Buyers League in 1968. Purchase year/price disputed (1958/$27,000 vs 1961/$26,000).
entities.provenance: Moyers & Company documentary; Coates 'The Case for Reparations'

entities.name: Betty Howard
entities.description: Black mother whose family moved into Trumbull Park Homes on July 30, 1953, triggering years of white violence.
entities.provenance: Encyclopedia of Chicago (D. Bradford Hunt); SAH Archipedia

entities.name: Donald Howard
entities.description: Husband of Betty Howard; co-head of the first Black family in Trumbull Park Homes.

entities.name: Richard Wright
entities.description: Author; set Native Son (1940) in the Black Belt and documented kitchenette life in 12 Million Black Voices (1941).

entities.name: Joe LaRue
entities.description: Moved to Chatham in 1960; emblematic second-wave far-South-Side pioneer.

entities.name: Billy Lamar Brooks Sr.
entities.description: North Lawndale activist who aided the Contract Buyers League; subject of Moyers short film 'The Guardian of North Lawndale.'

entities.name: Olivet Baptist Church
entities.description: South Side church at 3101 S. King Drive (from 1918); migrant reception, housing referrals, childcare, first kindergarten.

entities.name: Wabash Avenue YMCA
entities.description: 3763 S. Wabash; Rosenwald-funded Black YMCA (opened 1913/1914) providing lodging, job training, education to migrants.

entities.name: Chicago Defender
entities.description: Black newspaper; encouraged migration and circulated in the South via Illinois Central trains.

entities.name: Chicago Commission on Race Relations
entities.description: Appointed after the 1919 riot; produced the 672-page report The Negro in Chicago (1922).

entities.name: Chicago Housing Authority (CHA)
entities.description: Public housing agency; Neighborhood Composition Rule concentrated 1950s-60s projects in Black areas.

entities.name: Contract Buyers League
entities.description: Organization of Black contract homebuyers (from 1968) that fought speculators via payment strikes and lawsuits.

entities.name: The Black Belt
entities.description: Historic South Side Black settlement corridor; boundaries shifted 1919 (railroad-30th-40th-Ellis) through 1940s (Cermak-Lake Michigan-South Chicago-LaSalle).

entities.name: Bronzeville (Black Metropolis)
entities.description: Peak-era name for the Black Belt's city-within-a-city; ~300,000 residents, 22nd-63rd, State-Cottage Grove.

entities.name: North Lawndale
entities.description: West Side neighborhood; >90% Black by 1960; center of contract selling.
entities.provenance: UIC CAGIS via Chicago Agent Magazine; sibling brief

entities.name: Trumbull Park Homes
entities.description: CHA project; site of 1953-1963 white violence against Black residents.

entities.name: Illinois Central Station (12th & Michigan)
entities.description: Arrival point for most Great Migration trains; anchor of first-wave settlement geography.

entities.name: Chatham
entities.description: Far South Side neighborhood; blockbusting documented there in 1959; second-wave expansion frontier.

entities.name: Great Migration, First Wave
entities.description: c. 1916-1930; 50,000+ arrivals 1916-1919; confinement to the Black Belt.

entities.name: Great Migration, Second Wave
entities.description: 1940s-1960s; ~278,000 to ~813,000 Black Chicagoans; South and West Side expansion.

entities.name: Chicago Race Riot of 1919
entities.description: July 27-Aug 3, 1919; 38 dead, 537 injured, 1,000-2,000 homeless.

entities.name: Housing bombing campaign
entities.description: 58 racial bombings, July 1917-March 1921, concentrated in the Black settlement zone.

entities.name: Kitchenette
entities.description: Subdivided single-room tenure form; 3-5 families per original unit; enabler and constraint.

entities.name: Restrictive covenant
entities.description: Legal instrument barring Black occupancy; struck down in Hansberry v. Lee (1940), unenforceable after Shelley v. Kraemer (1948).

entities.name: Contract selling
entities.description: Predatory installment home sale with forfeiture clauses; targeted Black buyers denied mortgages.

entities.name: Blockbusting
entities.description: Panic-peddling tactic accelerating white flight and Black neighborhood turnover after 1948.

entities.name: Neighborhood Composition Rule
entities.description: CHA policy concentrating public housing in racially segregated areas.
